title: When Riemann flows with Wasserstein: Generative Modeling of Probability Distributions on Manifolds
abstract: arXiv:2609.25659v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many scientific datasets, such as molecular conformational ensembles or single-cell tissue measurements, are naturally modeled as meta-distributions: distributions over probability measures on non-Euclidean domains. Existing generative methods largely assume Euclidean geometry and fail to capture this structure. We introduce Riemannian Wasserstein Entropic Flow Matching (RWEFM), a generative framework on the Wasserstein space $\mathcal{P}_2(\mathcal{M})$ of a Riemannian manifold $(\mathcal{M},g)$. RWEFM is trained by regressing a neural vector field onto Riemannian optimal transport velocities, using McCann displacement interpolations as conditional paths. We confirm theoretically that this construction leads to a valid flow matching approach on $\mathcal{P}_2(\mathcal{M})$ and introduce the Riemannian Entropic Map, a GPU-efficient approximation of the optimal transport map on manifolds. translated_title: 当黎曼流形随Wasserstein流动：流形上概率分布的生成建模
translated_abstract: 许多科学数据集，如分子构象集合或单细胞组织测量数据，天然地可以被建模为元分布：即非欧几里得域上概率测度的分布。现有的生成方法大多假设欧几里得几何，无法捕捉这种结构。我们提出了黎曼Wasserstein熵流匹配（RWEFM），这是一个建立在黎曼流形 (M,g) 的Wasserstein空间 P₂(M) 上的生成框架。RWEFM通过将神经向量场回归到黎曼最优传输速度上进行训练，并使用McCann位移插值作为条件路径。我们从理论上证实了这一构造可以导出在 P₂(M) 上有效的流匹配方法，并引入了黎曼熵映射，这是一种在流形上对最优传输映射的GPU高效近似。我们的实验表明，通过尊重内在（几何结构）……
tldr: 提出了黎曼Wasserstein熵流匹配（RWEFM）框架，在黎曼流形的Wasserstein空间上实现生成建模，利用McCann位移插值和黎曼最优传输速度训练神经向量场，并引入GPU高效的黎曼熵映射来近似流形上的最优传输映射。
en_tdlr: We propose Riemannian Wasserstein Entropic Flow Matching (RWEFM), a generative framework on the Wasserstein space of Riemannian manifolds that trains neural vector fields via McCann displacement interpolations and Riemannian optimal transport velocities, together with a GPU-efficient Riemannian Entropic Map for approximating optimal transport maps on manifolds.
